questions.text: A 3x3 matrix has trace 6 and determinant 6, and one of its eigenvalues is 1. What is the sum of the squares of the other two eigenvalues?
questions.explain: The other two eigenvalues sum to 5 and multiply to 6, so they are 2 and 3. Sum of squares = 4 + 9 = 13.

questions.text: A system of 4 linear equations in 5 unknowns has a coefficient matrix of rank 3 and an augmented matrix of rank 3. What can be said about the solution set?
options: Infinitely many solutions with 2 free variables
Infinitely many solutions with 1 free variable
questions.explain: Equal ranks mean the system is consistent. The number of free variables is unknowns minus rank = 5 - 3 = 2.

questions.text: A test detects a disease with probability 0.99 when present and gives a false positive with probability 0.02. The disease affects 1 percent of the population. Given a positive test, what is the probability the person has the disease, rounded to three decimals?
questions.explain: By Bayes: (0.99 x 0.01) / (0.99 x 0.01 + 0.02 x 0.99) = 0.0099 / 0.0297 = 0.3333. Low prevalence keeps the posterior low despite a sensitive test.

questions.text: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum is 8, expressed as a decimal rounded to four places?
questions.explain: Favourable outcomes are (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2), so 5 of 36. That is 0.13889.

questions.text: A Poisson random variable has mean 4. What is its variance?
questions.explain: For a Poisson distribution the mean and variance are both equal to lambda, so the variance is 4.

questions.text: What is the maximum value of f(x) = x^3 - 3x on the closed interval [-2, 2]?
questions.explain: f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3 vanishes at x = 1 and x = -1. Evaluate: f(-2) = -2, f(-1) = 2, f(1) = -2, f(2) = 2. Maximum is 2, attained at both x = -1 and x = 2.

questions.text: Evaluate the definite integral of x from 0 to 3 of (2x + 1) dx.
questions.explain: The antiderivative is x^2 + x. Evaluated from 0 to 3: (9 + 3) - 0 = 12.

questions.text: What is the median of the data set 4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42?
questions.explain: With an even count the median is the mean of the two middle values: (15 + 16) / 2 = 15.5.
